reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel three-step sequential treatment (DCT + MAO + LST) that is not reported in any passage. It combines the bulk microstructural refinement of DCT (P11) with a MAO coating and laser texturing (P14) to create a synergistic effect, and it explicitly addresses the untested interaction between a DCT-modified substrate and a MAO/LST coating under fatigue, which goes beyond the individual or duplex treatments described in the literature.
copied_elements: DCT refines microstructure and increases hardness (P11)
MAO forms ceramic TiO2 coating (P14, P44)
LST reduces friction coefficient and improves MAO coating adhesion (P14)
Nitriding + texturing composite treatment can reduce friction and wear (P1, P10)
Duplex treatments (e.g., ZrN + shot peening) can improve wear and fatigue resistance (P9, P18)
